final: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS film_actor_count FROM film_actor AS fa JOIN film AS f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), totals AS (SELECT SUM(film_actor_count) AS total_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT rc.rating, rc.film_actor_count, 1.0 * rc.film_actor_count / t.total_count AS share FROM rating_counts AS rc JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rc.rating
